name: Daisuki na Kare to Tsukiau Tame ni Kirai na Otoko ni Karada o Yurusu Kanojo
original_name: 大好きな彼と付き合うためにキライな男に身体を許す彼女
source:
Due to certain circumstances, the [Heroine] Sayuri's 
unrequited feelings for her beloved are found out by a
[Guy She Despises] Yuuta and he uses the fact to force 
or into a physical relationship under the guise of 'helping'......

Sure, he does indeed help her out but, 
at the same time she erotically demands her body......

She despises him, so much... so very very much but...
she just cannot give up the opportunity to be united with 
the one that she truly loves and continues to endure......

This is the story of a girl, who puts up with having sex with 
a guy she despises, in order to go out with the guy she loves.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE205255.html]DLsite English[/url]]
